# Test font fixture

`ofl-test-bold.ttf` is a 13 KB subset (Basic Latin only, no layout features)
of Montserrat Bold, used only by the renderer tests (font rename and libass
frame tests). Montserrat is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 with
no Reserved Font Name; see `OFL.txt`. It is not a brand asset and is not used
for production renders (those use the git-ignored fonts in `lux-assets`).
